_comment_variable_conventions: These are INTERNAL variables used for callback-to-callback communication.
The underscore prefix signals 'do not set in session_parameters' -- they
are written by the LLM (via set_session_state) or by callbacks, never by
the caller. In evals, you should NEVER set these in session_parameters.
These are either INPUT variables (account_id, customer_id -- set by the
telephony platform) or DERIVED variables (auth_status, user_role -- set
by the before_agent_callback from API lookups).
auth_status defaults to '' so the before_agent_callback can use a simple
truthy check: if state.get('auth_status') --> falsy on first run, truthy
after being set. If the default were 'UNKNOWN', the callback would need
explicit value comparison, which is error-prone and verbose.
GECX session state only supports string values. The before_model_callback
name: sample_support_agent
description: Sample customer support agent demonstrating GECX best practices
_comment_model_settings: The '-live' suffix enables bidirectional streaming for voice.
_comment_audio_settings: AUDIO / LANGUAGE / TIMEZONE:
Set these for voice agents. Text-only agents can omit them.
toolExecutionMode: PARALLEL reduces latency by running independent
tool calls concurrently instead of sequentially.
'instruction' is the style prompt: an audio profile and a
director's note steering persona, pacing and intonation. It is
the platform-level control for tone, the way speakingRate is for
pace. A <persona> block in instruction.txt does not reach
delivery.
COMPOSITE MODELS ONLY. synthesizeSpeechConfigs configures a
separate synthesis step, and only a composite model has one.
This template runs gemini-3.1-flash-live, a native audio model
that speaks directly, so nothing in this block reaches it. Point
modelSettings.model at a composite model before tuning voice.
ADDING A LANGUAGE IS TWO EDITS, NOT ONE. synthesizeSpeechConfigs
is keyed by locale, matched case-insensitively, and its only
fallback is to the root language, so an 'es' entry serves 'es-US'
but an 'en-US' entry does not. A code added to
supportedLanguageCodes that no entry serves gets none of your
voice, speakingRate or instruction. Nothing fails on push. Lint
rule A007 catches it. Copy the whole en-US block and change only
the accent line, keeping the prompt body in one language so the
context never goes mixed-language:
"supportedLanguageCodes": ["es-US"],
"es-US": {
"speakingRate": 1.0,

"instruction": "...
Accent: Spanish accent
## Transcript:
"
AN INSTRUCTION NEEDS A GENERATIVE SYNTHESIS MODEL BESIDE IT. Set
"model": "gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview" in the same entry or the
default Chirp3-HD engine ignores the prompt. That switch also
forces bare voice names, so en-US-Chirp3-HD-Zephyr becomes Zephyr
and the voice audibly changes along with the tone.
If you set a named 'voice', name the same one in every locale so
the caller hears one person after a language switch. Left unset,
the service picks the default voice, which is already consistent
across languages.
See references/gecx-design-guide.md -> 'Style Prompts and
Per-Language Coverage'.
_comment_logging_settings: For VOICE/AUDIO agents ONLY: evaluationAudioRecordingConfig MUST be provided
to run audio evaluations. Without it, the platform will return a 400 BadRequestException.
For TEXT/CHAT agents: You can remove this entire evaluationAudioRecordingConfig block.
_comment_eval_thresholds: These control how goldens are scored. Adjust via app-thresholds.py.
extraToolCallBehavior: ALLOW lets the agent call extra tools without failing.
hallucinationMetricBehavior: DISABLED avoids false failures from the scorer.
